## Pull request overview

Fixes runtime failures when services are registered via async factories by resolving services through an async-first path in the dispatcher and framework adapters.

**Changes:**
- Added `HttpDispatcher.resolveService()` to prefer `kernel.getServiceAsync()` and updated dispatcher service lookups (including `protocol`) to use it.
- Updated all framework adapters’ auth resolution to prefer `getServiceAsync()` with sync fallback.
- Added/updated tests for dispatcher and selected adapters; updated `ROADMAP.md` entry.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 13 out of 13 changed files in this pull request and generated 13 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts | Introduces `resolveService()` and routes protocol/objectql/core services through it. |
| packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.test.ts | Adds tests for async-first resolution and fallthrough behavior. |
| packages/adapters/express/src/index.ts | Switches auth service lookup to async-first. |
| packages/adapters/fastify/src/index.ts | Switches auth service lookup to async-first. |
| packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts | Switches auth service lookup to async-first. |
| packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts | Adds adapter tests covering `getServiceAsync` auth resolution and fallthrough. |
| packages/adapters/nextjs/src/index.ts | Switches auth service lookup to async-first. |
| packages/adapters/nextjs/src/nextjs.test.ts | Adds adapter tests covering `getServiceAsync` auth resolution and fallthrough. |
| packages/adapters/sveltekit/src/index.ts | Switches auth service lookup to async-first. |
| packages/adapters/sveltekit/src/sveltekit.test.ts | Adds adapter tests covering `getServiceAsync` auth resolution and fallthrough. |
| packages/adapters/nestjs/src/index.ts | Switches auth service lookup to async-first. |
| packages/adapters/nuxt/src/index.ts | Switches auth service lookup to async-first. |
| ROADMAP.md | Updates roadmap note to reflect adapter coverage. |
</details>

NestJS adapter has tests, but they don’t cover the new auth resolution branch that prefers kernel.getServiceAsync(). Add a test that supplies getServiceAsync('auth') and asserts it is called (and a fallthrough test when it throws/returns null) to prevent regressions.

This catch-all treats any error during auth service resolution as "service not registered" and falls back to the dispatcher, which can mask real auth factory/initialization failures. Consider only swallowing expected lookup errors (not found / "is async") and rethrow unexpected errors so failures surface correctly.

Nuxt adapter has tests, but they don’t cover the new auth resolution branch that prefers kernel.getServiceAsync(). Add a test that supplies getServiceAsync('auth') and asserts the auth handler is used, plus a fallthrough test when getServiceAsync throws/returns null.

resolveService() currently catches *all* errors from kernel.getServiceAsync() and silently falls through. That can mask real service factory failures (misconfig/connection errors) and make the dispatcher behave as if the service is simply absent. Consider only falling through on "not found" (or other explicitly non-fatal) errors and rethrow unexpected errors so factory failures surface as 500s.

The Express adapter changed auth resolution to prefer kernel.getServiceAsync(), but the adapter test suite doesn’t cover this branch. Add a test that supplies getServiceAsync('auth') and asserts it is used (and another that asserts fallthrough when getServiceAsync throws/returns null) to prevent regressions.

Fastify adapter tests exist, but they don’t cover the new auth resolution branch that prefers kernel.getServiceAsync(). Add a test that provides getServiceAsync('auth') and asserts it is used, plus a fallthrough test when getServiceAsync throws/returns null.
